title: Ὁ Κῆπος καὶ Τὰ Ζῷα
subtitle: Unit 1 Visual Story — The Garden and the Animals

panels.scene: The farmer's garden is full of vegetables, trees, and fruit. Sheep and lambs graze peacefully inside.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ κῆπος καλός ἐστιν. τὰ πρόβατα καὶ τὰ ἀρνία ἐστὶν ἐν τῷ κήπῳ.
panels.englishCaption: The garden is beautiful. The sheep and lambs are in the garden.
panels.imageDescription: A lush garden with trees, vegetables, and peacefully grazing sheep and lambs

panels.scene: A wolf lurks at the edge of the garden, beyond the river. Its eyes are fixed on the lambs.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ λύκος ἐστὶν πέραν τοῦ ποταμοῦ. θέλει ἁρπάζειν τὸ ἀρνίον.
panels.englishCaption: The wolf is across the river. He wants to seize the lamb.
panels.imageDescription: A wolf watching from across a river, eyeing the lambs in the garden

panels.scene: The wolf runs into the garden and seizes a lamb. The farmer hears the lamb crying out and runs swiftly.
panels.greekCaption: κράζει τὸ ἀρνίον. ὁ γεωργὸς ἀκούει καὶ τρέχει ταχέως εἰς τὸν κῆπον.
panels.englishCaption: The lamb cries out. The farmer hears and runs quickly into the garden.
panels.imageDescription: A wolf grabbing a lamb while a farmer runs toward the garden with his staff

panels.scene: The farmer drives the wolf away with his rod. The wolf flees and the lamb is saved. The farmer gives thanks.
panels.greekCaption: ὁ γεωργὸς σῴζει τὸ ἀρνίον. ὁ λύκος φεύγει. εὐχαριστεῖ τῷ θεῷ.
panels.englishCaption: The farmer saves the lamb. The wolf flees. He gives thanks to God.
panels.imageDescription: The farmer standing victorious with his staff, the wolf fleeing, the saved lamb beside him
